_readme: Hand-authored names for the battleground entries data/map-entrances.json references. No levelMin/levelMax field, deliberately: unlike a dungeon or raid, a Classic battleground has no single canonical player level -- it's queued via 10-level brackets up through 60, so 'the battleground's own level range' isn't a well-defined single fact the way it is for a dungeon. Don't add one without deciding what it should actually mean first.
